summary.text: Yanira Gurrola Valenzuela is a Democratic member of the New Mexico House of Representatives from District 16, which she has represented since January 17, 2023, and she is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Albuquerque Public Schools teacher, she serves on the House Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Gurrola Valenzuela was born in Chihuahua, Mexico, and lives in New Mexico.

She earned a bachelor's degree in electronic industrial engineering from El Instituto Tecnológico de Chihuahua and a master's degree in curriculum and instructional leadership from The College of Santa Fe.

Her career experience includes working as a teacher with Albuquerque Public Schools and as a professional development coordinator, and she served on the board of directors of Dual Language Education New Mexico.
Gurrola Valenzuela was appointed to the New Mexico House of Representatives to fill the District 16 seat previously held by Antonio Maestas and took office on January 17, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as the House Education Committee and the Energy, Environment and Natural Resources Committee.
